flow.description: Validate incoming data against business rules and route to different processing paths based on validation results. Demonstrates conditional logic, data quality checks, and error handling.

data.label: Parse & Validate Data
Process Valid Data
data.script:
import datetime

validated_data = node_outputs.get('parse_and_validate', {})
customer = validated_data.get('customer_data', {})

# Process the valid customer data
output = {
    'status': 'processed',
    'customer_id': f"CUST-{customer.get('email', '').split('@')[0].upper()}",
    'processed_at': datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(),
    'customer_info': customer,
    'warnings': validated_data.get('warnings', []),
    'message': 'Customer data processed successfully'
}

data.label: Handle Invalid Data
data.script:
import datetime

validated_data = node_outputs.get('parse_and_validate', {})

# Log errors and create error report
output = {
    'status': 'rejected',
    'reason': 'validation_failed',
    'errors': validated_data.get('errors', []),
    'warnings': validated_data.get('warnings', []),
    'rejected_at': datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(),
    'original_data': validated_data.get('customer_data', {}),
    'message': 'Data validation failed - please correct errors and resubmit'
}
